Render-Path Unification — Wave 6 (2026-07-16): HARDEN the canonical-renderer proof surface

Phase: STRATEGIZE. The 5→3 renderer collapse is DONE. @barkpark/react is the ONE canonical JS renderer; the web/ fork is deleted (#3635), the blog-starter is migrated onto PortableDoc + /client hydration (#3636), the charter wave-log is sealed through W5 (#3638). This wave adds NO renderer surface. It CLOSES the 4 filed post-finale backlog proofs so the single renderer's guarantees are proven end-to-end, not assumed — every proof must FAIL when its guarantee is reverted (protective, anti-vacuous-green).

The wish (verbatim intent)

Harden four proofs, all inside js/packages/react + its test/proof packages + create-barkpark-app (blog-starter). Reuse the frozen pd-golden fixtures + the dom-shape comparator as-is; do NOT re-author the 42-block array.

  1. rpu-backlog-asciicast-full-render-proof — replace W4's stubbed-fetch ATTACH proof with a REAL asciicast render: commit a small .cast fixture and prove hydratePortableDoc drives asciinema-player to actually MOUNT and advance frames (not just attach a wrapper), closing the asciicast family end-to-end in vitest browser mode.
  2. rpu-backlog-toplaintext-typekeyed — prove toPlainText() covers EVERY type-keyed block across the 42-type grammar (type-keyed dispatch, no silent drop-to-empty), with a per-type golden assertion.
  3. rpu-backlog-field-embed-coverage — extend pd-golden coverage to the field-*/embed block set the 42-kitchen-sink under-covers (the schema-doc surface types), reusing the dom-shape comparator as-is.
  4. rpu-backlog-hydration-consuming-app-docs — prove hydratePortableDoc works in a REAL consuming-app docs surface (the create-barkpark-app blog-starter post page, or a docs page), beyond the isolated media-parity test package.

Direction — what "hardened" looks like

A cold reader opening this renderer must be able to TRUST four things, each held by a test that reddens the moment the guarantee is reverted:

  • An asciicast actually plays. Not "a wrapper div attached" — a real .cast fixture, and an assertion on terminal frame content changing over time in a real chromium. This is the one W4 explicitly left at attach-only (D21: the golden's src was a placeholder, no .cast existed in-repo).
  • toPlainText never silently drops a type. Today it only understands the Sanity _type:'block' shape and returns '' for the type-keyed AST. The hardened version walks the type-keyed grammar with a per-type golden assertion — the anti-vacuous mechanism is that a missing dispatch arm shows up as an empty string against a non-empty golden.
  • The schema-doc field/embed family is DOM-shape covered. This is the CRUX (see below).
  • Hydration works in a REAL app, not just an isolated harness. The media-parity package proves the transform fires in a synthetic consuming package; this proof lifts it into the actual blog-starter post surface that a scaffolded user ships.

The CRUX — field/embed coverage vs. "no new renderer surface"

Ground truth (verified at Strategize): grep -rnE "field-|embed|composite|arrayOf|codelist|localizedText" js/packages/react/src/ returns EMPTY. The canonical renderer dispatches ZERO of the 14 field-*/embed types. Charter D7 excluded them from W1 (schema-editor field renderers, no web-fork seed, never named in the blog wish).

The tension: the wish + the filed task both ask to "extend pd-golden coverage to the field-*/embed set" — but there is nothing to golden-cover, because the renderer emits nothing for those types. Meanwhile the lead mandate is explicit: "This wave HARDENS proofs; it does not add renderer surface."

My lean (tentative — Decide finalizes after survey): the static field-* family (field-string/slug/text/boolean/select/datetime/color/reference/image, composite, arrayOf, codelist, localizedText) is a mechanical 1:1 port of what walk.ex already emits (bp-field* static markup) — porting a proven emitter to close a filed coverage gap is coverage-hardening, NOT growing the blog grammar, which is what "no new surface" guards against. embed is different: it is a resolver-context block (PdEmbed target resolution), not static markup — I lean to DEFER embed's resolution and either scope it out or emit only an inert mount point. The survey must map exactly what walk.ex emits per type and whether Elixir goldens can be generated for them, so Decide can size this honestly instead of letting it balloon.

Locked constraints (from the lead)

  • Scope (strict): js/packages/react + its proof packages (media-parity browser-mode, next-parity) + js/packages/create-barkpark-app (blog-starter). DO-NOT-TOUCH: all templates/* (foreign search-template/site-spawner session), api/**/*.ex (felix — READ-ONLY for walk.ex targets), connectors. The web/ fork is DELETED — never resurrect it.
  • Every browser proof runs under vitest BROWSER mode (Playwright chromium) as the DEFAULT test script — never a test:browser side-script (a browser proof behind a side-script is never invoked → vacuous green; this bit W4's V2).
  • Anti-vacuous-green is non-negotiable: every proof must FAIL on revert. A test that passes both ways proves nothing.
  • js/ changes REQUIRE a changeset (Changeset-present is CORRECTNESS). js/ PRs merge on the Node gate ('Build + test + gates') + 'Twoslash type-check' + 'Generate reference' + doc-budgets. The Elixir Test gate is IRRELEVANT to js-only PRs.
  • Model: Fable is exhausted — every phase + every builder on Opus. NEVER Fable, NEVER Haiku. Builders commit to LOCAL worktree branches off origin/main and do NOT push; the steward pushes+PRs green branches. All branch work in worktrees cut from origin/main; the main checkout stays on main.

Reconciliation with what landed

  • W5 is ON origin/main: #3635 (web fork retired onto canonical), #3636 (blog-starter migrated to PortableDoc + client hydration), #3638 (charter W4+W5 wave-log). web/components/portable-doc.tsx no longer exists on origin/main.
  • W4 (#3604/#3605) shipped @barkpark/react/client hydratePortableDoc + the browser-mode media-parity proof + CI playwright gating. The asciicast leg is ATTACH-only by design (D21) — this wave's proof #1 finishes it.
  • The 42-type pd-golden fixtures + the Layer-2 dom-shape comparator are frozen and reused as-is (charter D9/D10). Proof #2 and #3 reuse them; proof #3 may need NEW goldens for the field-* family generated the same way.
  • The four target tasks are filed epic children and OPEN: rpu-backlog-asciicast-full-render-proof (#3584), rpu-backlog-toplaintext-typekeyed (#3420), rpu-backlog-field-embed-coverage, rpu-backlog-hydration-consuming-app-docs (#3583). NOTE: the field-embed filed task over-asks (all 14 impls + embed resolver); the hydration filed task is worded as "a docs recipe" but the wish reframes it as a real render+hydrate PROOF — Decide reconciles both.

Tentative wave shape (Decide finalizes)

Four file-disjoint proofs → parallel Opus builders, each committing to a local worktree branch off origin/main, each carrying a changeset, each shipping its own revert-red demonstration:

  • Proof #1 (asciicast) — media-parity package; a committed .cast fixture + a browser-mode frame-advance assertion.
  • Proof #2 (toPlainText) — src/toPlainText.ts type-keyed sibling + per-type golden assertions reusing the 42 pd-golden inputs.
  • Proof #3 (field/embed coverage) — the CRUX; scope pinned at Decide after field-embed-reality returns (static field-* port + golden vs. deferring embed's resolver).
  • Proof #4 (real-app hydration) — a render+hydrate assertion in the blog-starter post surface, beyond the isolated media-parity harness.

This Paper is the wave's living story. Digest appends the survey fold + verify plan before verifiers fly; Decide appends decisions + the slice plan before builders fly; Review closes it as the debrief.

DIGEST (2026-07-16): survey folded, verify fleet in flight

Status: DIGEST. 13 survey reports folded. This section appends the survey digest + the last-look verify fleet (5 assignments) BEFORE the verifiers fly. Decide finalizes scope after these return.

What the survey established

  • The 5→3 collapse is DONE and now essentially local. At survey time the checkout lagged origin/main by ~26 commits (client.ts, the media-parity package, the blog-starter island all existed on origin/main only); the checkout has since caught up to 1 commit behind. Builders still cut worktrees from origin/main — do not trust a bare local grep for W4/W5 surface.
  • Proof #1 (asciicast frame-advance) is technically real but has ONE sharp unknown. asciinema-player v3 renders terminal rows as DOM <span class="ap-line"> text (the single <canvas> is font-metrics only) — so "frames advanced" IS assertable as a text delta over time. BUT the canonical client.ts discards the player object returned by player.create() and mounts with poster:'npt:0:1' + no autoPlay. A poster paints a static t=1s snapshot with zero playback, so mere terminal-text presence is vacuous. The open question: can the test drive the already-mounted DOM (HARDEN-only) or must client.ts be changed to expose the player / pass autoPlay (renderer-adjacent)? This is the boundary between HARDEN-only and a small surface touch.
  • Proof #2 (toPlainText type-keyed) is NET-NEW behavior with NO source of truth. Current toPlainText handles only Sanity _type:'block' and silently drops all 42 type-keyed grammar blocks to ''. The 42 pd-golden .input objects key on type, not _type — so feeding them to today's impl returns '' for every one (the anti-vacuous baseline is real). CRITICAL: there is no Elixir per-type plain-text extractor to mirror — walk.ex is an HTML renderer; preview.ex only reads ingress/paragraph + the title-role block for a 110-char OG description. The 42 goldens carry expectedHtml, not expected plaintext. So per-type plain-text rules would be JS-INVENTED, and the "no silent drop" line must distinguish intentional skips (media/forms/chat/dataviz) from silent drops — that intent boundary is defined nowhere today.
  • Proof #3 (field-*/embed coverage) is THE CRUX, and it collides with two hard constraints. @barkpark/react dispatches ZERO of the 14 field-*/embed types; no goldens exist for any (both mirror dirs hold exactly 42). A GREEN protective parity assertion REQUIRES porting emitters into the JS renderer = new dispatch surface (collides with "no new renderer surface"), AND minting new goldens runs the Elixir generator + edits gen_pd_parity.ex / pd-parity-completeness.sh = touching api/**/.ex (collides with the felix DO-NOT-TOUCH scope). Survey refinement: the static/portable family is 13 (all field-* + composite/arrayOf/codelist/localizedText; field-reference/codelist fall back deterministically with no resolver), embed is the sole true resolver-context type → DEFER. The filed task over-asks (all 14 + embed resolver).
  • Proof #4 (real-consuming-app hydration) is mostly already WIRED — only the PROOF is missing. The blog-starter post page already renders <PortableDocSurface> (a 'use client' island: useRef + dangerouslySetInnerHTML(renderPortableDocument) + useEffect(hydratePortableDoc(ref.current)), zero next/* imports). What is missing is a browser-mode test that mounts it and asserts hydration fires. create-barkpark-app's vitest is node-env (cannot hydrate) — proof #4 MUST be browser mode (media-parity style, DEFAULT test script), not next-parity (node/happy-dom parses dead HTML = vacuous). The filed task #3583 is worded as a docs recipe; the wish reframes it as a render+hydrate proof.

Where reports agree, and the one tension they surface

No surveyor contradicted another on evidence. The single load-bearing tension (wish vs. constraint, not a survey conflict) is that proofs #2 and #3 both require NEW dispatch/behavior in the renderer, which collides head-on with "no new renderer surface," and proof #3 additionally collides with the felix api/**/.ex DO-NOT-TOUCH scope for golden minting. Decide cannot ship without ruling on this. The tentative direction: (a) porting the 13 static field-* emitters to close a FILED coverage gap is HARDENING, not growth; (b) embed is deferred (scope-out or inert-fallback golden); (c) toPlainText's type-keyed sibling is a new function over a different shape (not a mutation of the Sanity fn — its 7 tests stay untouched).

After-1s advance frame defeats the poster-vacuousness trap; DOM-click keeps client.ts untouched (autoPlay/seek would force a renderer edit). Revert-red neuter proves the click load-bearing. Clones media-parity's browser config + the four load-bearing knobs; imports the real island read-only. The written CSP/engine-load recipe stays deferred (rpu-backlog-hydration-consuming-app-docs).
  • D38 — 3 file-disjoint slices, all Opus, worktrees off origin/main. Builders commit locally & don't push; steward pushes+PRs green branches; lead merges and flips each "PR merged" criterion.
